speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function; to start our investigation, have you noticed any changes in your skin color, such as jaundice or darkening of the urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your history. Given your age, sexual activity with multiple female partners, and inconsistent condom use, have you noticed any new lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin? Also, have you experienced any unexplained weight loss or fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV-associated cholangiopathy.

The patient's history of multiple female partners, inconsistent condom use, severe pruritus, scleral icterus, and fatigue is highly suggestive of an opportunistic infection of the biliary tree caused by HIV. I request the results of an HIV test and an Abdominal Ultrasound to confirm the presence of biliary strictures or stones.
